panels.title: Visitors now
panels.description: Distinct visitors in the 5 minutes before the end of the range.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))
SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS "Visitors now" FROM web WHERE ts >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

panels.title: Page views
panels.description: page_viewed events in the range, and page views per visit (a visit ends after 30 minutes without an event).
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix)
SELECT sum(views) AS "Page views", round(sum(views) / nullIf(count(), 0), 2) AS "Views per visit" FROM visits

panels.title: Top channels
panels.description: The five channels the most visitors came from: each visitor-day counted once, by the channel of its first visit.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),
first AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, toDate(max(stop)) AS d,
         argMin(multiIf(
  med IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid', 'paidsearch', 'paid_search') OR click IN ('google', 'microsoft'), 'Paid search',
  med IN ('paid_social', 'paidsocial', 'social_paid', 'paid-social') OR click IN ('meta', 'tiktok', 'linkedin'), 'Paid social',
  med IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'programmatic'), 'Display',
  med IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter'), 'Email',
  med = 'affiliate', 'Affiliate',
  match(ref, '(^|\\.)(chatgpt\\.com|chat\\.openai\\.com|perplexity\\.ai|claude\\.ai|gemini\\.google\\.com|copilot\\.microsoft\\.com|you\\.com)$')
    OR src IN ('chatgpt.com', 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'claude'), 'AI assistants',
  med IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm')
    OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(facebook|instagram|linkedin|lnkd|reddit|youtube|tiktok|pinterest|threads|bsky|mastodon|t)\\.(com|co|in|app|social|net)$|(^|\\.)(x\\.com|news\\.ycombinator\\.com)$'), 'Organic social',
  med = 'organic' OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(google|bing|duckduckgo|yahoo|baidu|yandex|ecosia|brave|kagi|startpage|qwant)\\.'), 'Organic search',
  src != '' OR med != '', 'Other campaign',
  ref = '', 'Direct',
  'Referral'), start) AS channel,
         argMin(if(src != '', src, if(ref != '', ref, '(direct)')), start) AS source,
         argMin(entry_route, start) AS landing,
         argMin(ref, start) AS referrer, argMin(ref_path, start) AS referrer_path,
         argMin(src, start) AS utm_source, argMin(med, start) AS utm_medium, argMin(campaign, start) AS utm_campaign,
         argMin(term, start) AS utm_term, argMin(content, start) AS utm_content,
         argMin(country, start) AS country_code, argMin(device, start) AS device_type,
         argMin(browser, start) AS browser_name, argMin(os, start) AS os_name,
         count() AS n_visits, countIf(views = 1 AND actions = 0) AS bounces
  FROM visits GROUP BY EnvId, h)
SELECT channel, count() AS "Visitors"
FROM first GROUP BY channel ORDER BY "Visitors" DESC, channel LIMIT 5

panels.description: Browser errors (error_events, kept 14 days by default) per thousand page views in the range. The project's frontend dashboard has the errors, issues and web vitals.

WITH web AS (

    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))

panels.title: New users
panels.description: Users who signed up; in an environment that reported no sign-up in the 90 days before, the users first seen, except those first seen within 7 days of the earliest event retained (they may be returning, and count as returning). No figure when nothing in the 7 days can be decided. Always the 7 days before the end of the range, whatever range is selected, beside the 7 days before them, as the Users card counts.
panels.sql:
SELECT (SELECT if((SELECT count() > 0 AND countIf(DecidedFrom < {to:DateTime64(9)}) = 0 FROM (SELECT EnvId, toUInt8(max(has_signup)) AS ReportsSignups, min(first_at) AS DataFrom,
       if(max(has_signup) = 1, toDateTime64(0, 9), min(first_at) + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS DecidedFrom
FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
GROUP BY EnvId) WHERE EnvId IN (SELECT EnvId FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)})), NULL, (SELECT count() FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)) WHERE NewAt >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY))) AS "New users (7 days)",
       (SELECT if((SELECT count() > 0 AND countIf(DecidedFrom < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0 FROM (SELECT EnvId, toUInt8(max(has_signup)) AS ReportsSignups, min(first_at) AS DataFrom,
       if(max(has_signup) = 1, toDateTime64(0, 9), min(first_at) + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS DecidedFrom
FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,

    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
GROUP BY EnvId) WHERE EnvId IN (SELECT EnvId FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY)), NULL, (SELECT count() FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)) WHERE NewAt >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 7 DAY))) AS "Previous 7 days"

panels.description: The share of server requests each service.version served, per bucket: a rollout is one band replacing another.

SELECT t, version AS "Version", round(n / sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY t), 4) AS "Share of requests"
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, if(ResourceAttributes['service.version'] = '', '(unversioned)', ResourceAttributes['service.version']) AS version,
           sum(if(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)') = '', 1.0, round(least(1000000.0, 1 / greatest(1 - reinterpretAsUInt64(reverse(unhex(concat('00', rightPad(left(extract(TraceState, '(?:^|,)ot=(?:[^;,]*;)*th:([0-9a-f]+)(?:[;,]|$)'), 14), 14, '0'))))) / 72057594037927936, 0.000001)), 6))) AS n
    FROM otel_traces
    WHERE SpanKind IN ('Server', 'SPAN_KIND_SERVER') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))

panels.sql:
SELECT first_version AS "Version", count() AS "New issues"
FROM (
    SELECT ServiceName, Fingerprint, min(Timestamp) AS first_seen,
           argMin(if(ServiceVersion = '', '(unversioned)', ServiceVersion), Timestamp) AS first_version,
           countIf(Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)}) AS events
    FROM (
        SELECT ServiceName, Fingerprint, Timestamp, ServiceVersion
        FROM server_error_events
        WHERE Fingerprint != '' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, ServiceName))
        UNION ALL
        SELECT e.ServiceName AS ServiceName, s.fp AS Fingerprint, e.Timestamp AS Timestamp, e.ServiceVersion AS ServiceVersion
        FROM error_events AS e
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT ServiceName, ServiceVersion, RawStackHash, argMax(Fingerprint, UpdatedAt) AS fp
            FROM error_stacks
            GROUP BY ServiceName, ServiceVersion, RawStackHash
        ) AS s ON e.ServiceName = s.ServiceName AND e.ServiceVersion = s.ServiceVersion AND e.RawStackHash = s.RawStackHash
        WHERE s.fp != '' AND e.Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND e.Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, e.EnvId)) AND (empty({services:Array(String)}) OR has({services:Array(String)}, e.ServiceName))
    )
    GROUP BY ServiceName, Fingerprint
)
WHERE first_seen >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND events >= 3
GROUP BY first_version
ORDER BY min(first_seen), first_version

dashboards.title: shop: jobs
dashboards.description: Every job and cron job of the project: runs, failures, duration and last run per job, from the Kubernetes Job events, plus container restarts, warning events and error logs. Present in deployed environments only. The service selector picks a job by its name, a workload name, a service.name or a run name, on every panel alike.

panels.title: Runs per job
panels.description: Per job over the selected range: runs seen, succeeded and failed, the latest run's start, and run durations (seconds, start to completion). One row per forge job. A run is one Kubernetes Job in one environment, however many pods it created.
panels.sql:
SELECT job,
       count() AS runs,
       countIf(finished > 0) AS succeeded,
       countIf(failed) AS failed,
       max(started) AS last_started,
       tupleElement(argMax(tuple(if(finished > 0 AND started > 0, dateDiff('second', started, finished), NULL)), started), 1) AS last_duration_s,
       if(countIf(finished > 0 AND started > 0) = 0, NULL, round(avgIf(dateDiff('second', started, finished), finished > 0 AND started > 0), 1)) AS avg_duration_s,
       if(countIf(finished > 0 AND started > 0) = 0, NULL, maxIf(dateDiff('second', started, finished), finished > 0 AND started > 0)) AS max_duration_s
FROM (
  SELECT env, run, job, started, finished, failed_at, failure, failed
  FROM (
  SELECT env, run, any(job) AS job,
         minIf(Timestamp, reason = 'SuccessfulCreate') AS started,
         maxIf(Timestamp, reason = 'Completed') AS finished,
         maxIf(Timestamp, reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) AS failed_at,
         argMaxIf(reason, Timestamp, reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) AS failure,
         countIf(reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) > 0 AS failed
  FROM (
    SELECT Timestamp, env, run, uid, job, reason,
           sum(reason = 'SuccessfulCreate' AND prev IN ('Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) OVER (PARTITION BY env, run, uid ORDER BY Timestamp, ended ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS generation
    FROM (
      SELECT Timestamp, env, run, uid, job, reason, reason IN ('Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy') AS ended,
             lagInFrame(reason, 1, '') OVER (PARTITION BY env, run, uid ORDER BY Timestamp, ended ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS prev
      FROM (
WITH [('shop-migrate', ['shop-migrate'], ['shop-migrate']), ('shop-prune', ['shop-prune'], ['shop-prune'])] AS job_identity,
  arrayMap(j -> j.1, if(empty({services:Array(String)}), job_identity,
    arrayFilter(j -> arrayExists(s -> has(j.3, s) OR arrayExists(w -> match(s, concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), {services:Array(String)}), job_identity))) AS selected_jobs
SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env, ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'] AS run,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.object.uid'] AS uid, LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] AS reason, tupleElement(arrayFirst(j -> arrayExists(w -> match(ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'], concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), job_identity), 1) AS job
FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] IN ('SuccessfulCreate', 'Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')
  AND if(mapContains(LogAttributes, 'k8s.object.kind'), LogAttributes['k8s.object.kind'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.object.kind']) = 'Job'
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id']))
  AND job != '' AND has(selected_jobs, job)
      )
    )
  )
  GROUP BY env, run, uid, generation
  )
)
GROUP BY job
ORDER BY last_started DESC, job

panels.description: Runs started over time, one line per job. A run is one Kubernetes Job in one environment, however many pods it created.
panels.sql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(started, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, job, count() AS runs
FROM (
  SELECT env, run, job, started, finished, failed_at, failure, failed
  FROM (
  SELECT env, run, any(job) AS job,
         minIf(Timestamp, reason = 'SuccessfulCreate') AS started,
         maxIf(Timestamp, reason = 'Completed') AS finished,
         maxIf(Timestamp, reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) AS failed_at,
         argMaxIf(reason, Timestamp, reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) AS failure,
         countIf(reason IN ('BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) > 0 AS failed
  FROM (
    SELECT Timestamp, env, run, uid, job, reason,
           sum(reason = 'SuccessfulCreate' AND prev IN ('Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')) OVER (PARTITION BY env, run, uid ORDER BY Timestamp, ended ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS generation
    FROM (
      SELECT Timestamp, env, run, uid, job, reason, reason IN ('Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy') AS ended,
             lagInFrame(reason, 1, '') OVER (PARTITION BY env, run, uid ORDER BY Timestamp, ended ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS prev
      FROM (
WITH [('shop-migrate', ['shop-migrate'], ['shop-migrate']), ('shop-prune', ['shop-prune'], ['shop-prune'])] AS job_identity,
  arrayMap(j -> j.1, if(empty({services:Array(String)}), job_identity,
    arrayFilter(j -> arrayExists(s -> has(j.3, s) OR arrayExists(w -> match(s, concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), {services:Array(String)}), job_identity))) AS selected_jobs
SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env, ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'] AS run,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.object.uid'] AS uid, LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] AS reason, tupleElement(arrayFirst(j -> arrayExists(w -> match(ResourceAttributes['k8s.workload.name'], concat('^', w, '(-[0-9a-f]{6,12})?$')), j.2), job_identity), 1) AS job
FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.event.reason'] IN ('SuccessfulCreate', 'Completed', 'BackoffLimitExceeded', 'DeadlineExceeded', 'PodFailurePolicy')
  AND if(mapContains(LogAttributes, 'k8s.object.kind'), LogAttributes['k8s.object.kind'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.object.kind']) = 'Job'
  AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id']))

    )
  )
  GROUP BY env, run, uid, generation
  )
)
WHERE started > 0
GROUP BY t, job
ORDER BY t, job

FROM (

dashboards.title: shop: users
dashboards.description: Who uses the product: accounts, active users (any signed-in product event), new users (sign-ups, or the users first seen when the environment reports no sign-ups) and returning users, engagement, weekly retention and how people sign up and sign in. A user is counted once per environment. Hosted environments only: a local forge env up has no product_events table.

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts in the environment's identity instance, from the platform's daily auth_accounts snapshot (the newest in the 3 days before the end of the range). An environment with no snapshot shows its distinct users seen in the 90 days before the end of the range instead. The trend is each day's snapshot.
panels.sql:
SELECT sum(if(has_snapshot, snapshot, toInt64(seen))) AS "Accounts"
FROM (
    SELECT EnvId,
           countIf(EventName = 'auth_accounts' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 3 DAY) > 0 AS has_snapshot,
           argMaxIf(toInt64OrZero(Props['total']), Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_accounts' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 3 DAY) AS snapshot,
           uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state') AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (EventName = 'auth_accounts' OR (UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state'))
    GROUP BY EnvId)
panels.trendSql:
SELECT day, sum(total) AS "Accounts"
FROM (
    SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, EnvId, argMax(toInt64OrZero(Props['total']), Timestamp) AS total
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_accounts' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY day, EnvId)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users with any signed-in product event in the range (a sign-in, the daily session heartbeat, a CRUD write, an app event). The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS "Active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
panels.trendSql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS "Active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: New users
panels.description: Users whose first auth_signed_up is in the range; where no sign-up was reported in the 90 days before its end, the users first seen in the range, except those within 7 days of the earliest event retained (the data begins there; they count as returning). No figure when no part of the range is decided. The Authentication section says which rule applies, and from when. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
SELECT if((SELECT count() > 0 AND countIf(DecidedFrom < {to:DateTime64(9)}) = 0 FROM (SELECT EnvId, toUInt8(max(has_signup)) AS ReportsSignups, min(first_at) AS DataFrom,
       if(max(has_signup) = 1, toDateTime64(0, 9), min(first_at) + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS DecidedFrom
FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
GROUP BY EnvId) WHERE EnvId IN (SELECT EnvId FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)})), NULL, (SELECT count() FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)) WHERE NewAt >= {from:DateTime64(9)})) AS "New users"
panels.trendSql:
SELECT toDate(NewAt) AS day, count() AS "New users"
FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY))
WHERE NewAt >= {from:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Returning users
panels.description: Active users in the range who are not new in it. No figure when the range decides no new users (New's description says when).

    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
GROUP BY EnvId) WHERE EnvId IN (SELECT EnvId FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)})), NULL, uniqExact((EnvId, UserId))) AS "Returning users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))

FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,

  FROM (

    FROM product_events

WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)) WHERE NewAt >= {from:DateTime64(9)})

panels.title: Daily, weekly and monthly active users
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users each UTC day, and over the 7 and 30 days ending that day.
panels.sql:
SELECT addDays(seen, offset) AS day, uniqExactIf((EnvId, UserId), offset = 0) AS "Daily active",
       uniqExactIf((EnvId, UserId), offset < 7) AS "Weekly active",
       uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS "Monthly active"
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT EnvId, UserId, toDate(Timestamp) AS seen
    FROM product_events

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU / MAU)

panels.sql:
SELECT round(avg(dau) / nullIf(avg(mau), 0), 4) AS "DAU / MAU"
FROM (
SELECT addDays(seen, offset) AS day, uniqExactIf((EnvId, UserId), offset = 0) AS dau, uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS mau
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT EnvId, UserId, toDate(Timestamp) AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= toStartOfDay({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
)
ARRAY JOIN range(30) AS offset
WHERE day >= toDate({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(day) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day)

panels.title: Lifecycle per week
panels.description: Each ISO week's active users in exactly one class: new (their sign-up week), retained (also active the week before), resurrected (back after a week or more away), and below zero the users active the week before but not this week (churned). The current week counts no churn until it is over.
panels.sql:
WITH
u AS (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, groupUniqArray(toMonday(Timestamp)) AS wks
  FROM product_events
  WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= toMonday({from:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  GROUP BY EnvId, UserId),
s AS (SELECT EnvId, UserId, toMonday(NewAt) AS sw FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)))
SELECT week, countIf(state = 'new') AS "New", countIf(state = 'retained') AS "Retained",
       countIf(state = 'resurrected') AS "Resurrected", -countIf(state = 'churned') AS "Churned"
FROM (
  SELECT wk AS week, multiIf(s.sw = wk, 'new', has(u.wks, wk - 7), 'retained', 'resurrected') AS state
  FROM u ARRAY JOIN u.wks AS wk
  LEFT JOIN s ON s.EnvId = u.EnvId AND s.UserId = u.UserId
  UNION ALL
  SELECT wk + 7 AS week, 'churned' AS state
  FROM u ARRAY JOIN u.wks AS wk
  WHERE NOT has(u.wks, wk + 7) AND wk + 7 < toMonday({to:DateTime64(9)}))
WHERE week >= toMonday({from:DateTime64(9)}) AND toDateTime(week) < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

panels.title: Time to activation
panels.description: The range's sign-ups by the time from signing up to the first <entity>_created event (the automatic CRUD event). Not yet: no activation by the end of the range.
panels.sql:
WITH su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
act AS (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, concat('u:', UserId) AS person, min(Timestamp) AS at
  FROM product_events
  WHERE UserId != '' AND match(EventName, '_created$') AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
  GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
SELECT bucket AS "Time to activation", count() AS "Sign-ups"
FROM (
  SELECT multiIf(x.UserId = '', 'Not yet',
                 secs < 3600, '< 1 hour', secs < 86400, '1-24 hours', secs < 3 * 86400, '1-3 days', secs < 7 * 86400, '3-7 days', '> 7 days') AS bucket
  FROM (
    SELECT x.UserId AS UserId, greatest(0, dateDiff('second', s.at, x.at)) AS secs
    FROM su AS s LEFT JOIN act AS x ON x.EnvId = s.EnvId AND x.UserId = s.UserId) AS x)
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY indexOf(['< 1 hour', '1-24 hours', '1-3 days', '3-7 days', '> 7 days', 'Not yet'], bucket)

panels.title: Where auth events come from
panels.description: The clients that reported auth events in the range (backend, web, …). A last row says when the environment reports no sign-ups, so new users are the ones first seen, and from when, when that is inside the range: before then a user first seen may be returning.
panels.sql:
SELECT client AS "Client", signups AS "Sign-ups", credential AS "Sign-ins (credential)", resumed AS "Sign-ins (resumed)", signouts AS "Sign-outs"
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS o, if(Client = '', 'unknown', Client) AS client,
         countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signups,
         countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_in' AND Props['kind'] = 'credential') AS credential,
         countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_in' AND Props['kind'] = 'resumed') AS resumed,
         countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_out') AS signouts
  FROM product_events
  WHERE EventName IN ('auth_signed_up', 'auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out') AND Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
  GROUP BY client
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1, if(decided > {from:DateTime64(9)},
               concat('sign-ups not reported: new users are the users first seen from ', formatDateTime(decided, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i', 'UTC'),
                      ' UTC, 7 days after the earliest event retained; a user first seen before then may be returning and counts as returning'),
               'sign-ups not reported: new users are the users first seen'), 0, 0, 0, 0
  FROM (SELECT count() AS n, (SELECT max(DecidedFrom) FROM (SELECT EnvId, toUInt8(max(has_signup)) AS ReportsSignups, min(first_at) AS DataFrom,
       if(max(has_signup) = 1, toDateTime64(0, 9), min(first_at) + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS DecidedFrom
FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
GROUP BY EnvId)) AS decided
        FROM product_events WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)})
  WHERE n = 0)
ORDER BY o, client

panels.title: Page views
panels.description: page_viewed events in the range. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,

         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk

  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix)

panels.title: Events by name
panels.description: Every product event in the range but page views: how often, by how many persons, and when it was last seen.
panels.sql:
WITH stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
persons AS (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.EnvId AS EnvId, e.EventName AS EventName, e.Props AS Props, e.UserId AS UserId,
         multiIf(e.UserId != '', concat('u:', e.UserId),
                 l.uid != '' AND e.Privacy = '', concat('u:', l.uid),
                 e.VisitorId != '', concat('v:', e.VisitorId),
                 e.DayVisitor != '', concat('d:', e.DayVisitor), '') AS person
  FROM (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, EventName, Props, UserId, VisitorId, DayVisitor, Privacy
        FROM product_events WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DeviceType != 'bot' AND EventName NOT IN ('page_viewed', 'auth_accounts')) AS e
  LEFT JOIN stitch AS l ON l.EnvId = e.EnvId AND l.h = e.DayVisitor)
SELECT EventName AS "Event", count() AS "Events", uniqExactIf((EnvId, person), person != '') AS "Persons",
       toDateTime(max(ts), 'UTC') AS "Last seen"
FROM persons GROUP BY EventName ORDER BY "Events" DESC, "Event" LIMIT 50

  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),
su AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events
    WHERE EventName = 'auth_signed_up' AND UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
  WHERE at >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)}),
su_h AS (
  SELECT su.EnvId AS EnvId, su.UserId AS UserId, su.at AS at, su.d AS d,
         if(su.own_h != '', su.own_h, l.h) AS h,
         su.method AS method, su.provider AS provider, su.social AS social, su.verified AS verified
  FROM su LEFT JOIN (SELECT EnvId, uid, d, any(h) AS h FROM stitch GROUP BY EnvId, uid, d HAVING count() = 1) AS l
    ON l.EnvId = su.EnvId AND l.uid = su.UserId AND l.d = su.d),

  SELECT EnvId, UserId, concat('u:', UserId) AS person, min(Timestamp) AS at
  FROM product_events

  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.EnvId AS EnvId, e.EventName AS EventName, e.Props AS Props, e.UserId AS UserId,
         multiIf(e.UserId != '', concat('u:', e.UserId),
                 l.uid != '' AND e.Privacy = '', concat('u:', l.uid),
                 e.VisitorId != '', concat('v:', e.VisitorId),

WITH web AS (

  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 35 DAY + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts

  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),

         argMin(multiIf(

  med IN ('paid_social', 'paidsocial', 'social_paid', 'paid-social') OR click IN ('meta', 'tiktok', 'linkedin'), 'Paid social',

  med = 'organic' OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(google|bing|duckduckgo|yahoo|baidu|yandex|ecosia|brave|kagi|startpage|qwant)\\.'), 'Organic search',

  ref = '', 'Direct',
  'Referral'), start) AS channel,
         argMin(if(src != '', src, if(ref != '', ref, '(direct)')), start) AS source,

         argMin(ref, start) AS referrer, argMin(ref_path, start) AS referrer_path,
         argMin(src, start) AS utm_source, argMin(med, start) AS utm_medium, argMin(campaign, start) AS utm_campaign,
         argMin(term, start) AS utm_term, argMin(content, start) AS utm_content,
         argMin(country, start) AS country_code, argMin(device, start) AS device_type,
         argMin(browser, start) AS browser_name, argMin(os, start) AS os_name,

  FROM visits GROUP BY EnvId, h),
stitch AS (
  SELECT EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, any(UserId) AS uid, toDate(max(Timestamp)) AS d
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 35 DAY + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND DayVisitor != '' AND UserId != '' AND Privacy = ''
  GROUP BY EnvId, h HAVING uniqExact(UserId) = 1),

  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS at, toDate(min(Timestamp)) AS d,
           argMinIf(DayVisitor, Timestamp, DayVisitor != '') AS own_h,
           argMin(Props['method'], Timestamp) AS method, argMin(Props['provider'], Timestamp) AS provider,
           argMin(Props['social_provider'], Timestamp) AS social, argMin(Props['verified'], Timestamp) AS verified
    FROM product_events

  WHERE at >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND at < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 35 DAY),

  SELECT su.EnvId AS EnvId, su.UserId AS UserId, su.at AS at, su.d AS d,
         if(su.own_h != '', su.own_h, l.h) AS h,
         su.method AS method, su.provider AS provider, su.social AS social, su.verified AS verified
  FROM su LEFT JOIN (SELECT EnvId, uid, d, any(h) AS h FROM stitch GROUP BY EnvId, uid, d HAVING count() = 1) AS l

  INNER JOIN (SELECT EnvId, UserId, Timestamp FROM product_events
              WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY + INTERVAL 28 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}) AS e

  WHERE e.Timestamp >= u.at + INTERVAL 28 DAY AND e.Timestamp < u.at + INTERVAL 35 DAY)

FROM su_h AS u LEFT JOIN first AS f ON f.EnvId = u.EnvId AND f.h = u.h
GROUP BY "Channel" ORDER BY "Sign-ups" DESC, "Channel"

panels.description: Distinct workflow runs (forge.ai.run.id) with any span in the range. A run that continues in a new trace stays one run. The trend is each UTC day's.

WITH ai AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, TraceId, SpanName, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Duration,
         SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] AS op, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AS is_call, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AS is_tool, (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled') AS failed,
         if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS model, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS provider,
         toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) AS in_tok, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS out_tok, toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'])) AS cache_read_tok,

         SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS error_type, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool,

  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '')),

         countIf(op = 'invoke_workflow') AS segments,

  FROM ai WHERE run_id != '' GROUP BY run_id)

panels.title: Runs by outcome
panels.description: Runs by the UTC day they started and how they ended: succeeded, failed, cancelled, or in progress (the workflow span is not reported yet).
panels.sql:
WITH ai AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, TraceId, SpanName, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Duration,
         SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] AS op, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AS is_call, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AS is_tool, (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled') AS failed,
         if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS model, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS provider,
         toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) AS in_tok, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS out_tok, toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'])) AS cache_read_tok,
         toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd'])) AS cost, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.workflow.name'] AS workflow, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] AS run_id,
         SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS error_type, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool,
         SpanAttributes['user.id'] AS user_id, SpanAttributes['org.id'] AS org_id
  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '')),
runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, anyIf(workflow, workflow != '') AS wf,
         min(ts) AS started, max(addNanoseconds(ts, Duration)) AS ended,
         (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(ended) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(started)) / 1e9 AS seconds,
         countIf(op = 'invoke_workflow') AS segments,
         multiIf(segments = 0, 'In progress',
                 argMaxIf(error_type, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow') = 'canceled', 'Cancelled',
                 argMaxIf(failed, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow'), 'Failed', 'Succeeded') AS outcome,
         countIf(is_call) AS calls, countIf(is_tool) AS tools,
         sumIf(in_tok, is_call) AS run_in, sumIf(out_tok, is_call) AS run_out, sumIf(cost, is_call) AS run_cost
  FROM ai WHERE run_id != '' GROUP BY run_id)
SELECT toDate(started) AS day, outcome, count() AS "Runs"
FROM runs GROUP BY day, outcome ORDER BY day, outcome

panels.sql:
WITH ai AS (

         SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] AS op, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AS is_call, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AS is_tool, (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled') AS failed,

  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '')),
runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, anyIf(workflow, workflow != '') AS wf,
         min(ts) AS started, max(addNanoseconds(ts, Duration)) AS ended,
         (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(ended) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(started)) / 1e9 AS seconds,
         countIf(op = 'invoke_workflow') AS segments,
         multiIf(segments = 0, 'In progress',
                 argMaxIf(error_type, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow') = 'canceled', 'Cancelled',
                 argMaxIf(failed, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow'), 'Failed', 'Succeeded') AS outcome,
         countIf(is_call) AS calls, countIf(is_tool) AS tools,
         sumIf(in_tok, is_call) AS run_in, sumIf(out_tok, is_call) AS run_out, sumIf(cost, is_call) AS run_cost

panels.title: Providers and models
panels.description: Calls, failed calls, latency (p50, p95), time to first token of streamed calls (p50; a gen_ai.first_token event), output tokens per second of call time, tokens, the prompt cache hit ratio, and the gateway-reported cost.
panels.sql:
SELECT if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS "Provider", if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS "Model", count() AS "Calls",
       round(countIf((StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled')) / count(), 4) AS "Error rate",
       round(quantile(0.5)(Duration / 1e6)) AS "p50 ms", round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e6)) AS "p95 ms",
       round(quantile(0.5)(if(indexOf(Events.Name, 'gen_ai.first_token') = 0, NULL, (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Events.Timestamp[indexOf(Events.Name, 'gen_ai.first_token')]) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp)) / 1e6))) AS "TTFT p50 ms",
       round(sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) / nullIf(sumIf(Duration, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) > 0) / 1e9, 0), 1) AS "Output tok/s",
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) AS "Input tokens", sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS "Output tokens",
       round(sum(toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens']))) / nullIf(sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])), 0), 4) AS "Cache hit",
       round(sum(toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd']))), 4) AS "Reported cost (USD)"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']
GROUP BY "Provider", "Model" ORDER BY "Calls" DESC LIMIT 50

dashboards.title: shop: AI errors & retries
dashboards.description: Failed model calls by class (error.type), provider and model; retries and backoffs; and failed runs with the span that failed first. A cancellation is never a failure. From the GenAI spans in the environment's traces, so the range is bounded by their retention.

panels.title: Call error rate
panels.description: Failed model calls over all model calls in the range. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql: SELECT round(countIf((StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled')) / nullIf(count(), 0), 4) AS "Error rate" FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']

panels.title: Retries

panels.title: Failed calls by class
panels.description: Failed model calls each UTC day by error.type; a span that names none is unclassified.
panels.sql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, if(SpanAttributes['error.type'] = '', 'unclassified', SpanAttributes['error.type']) AS class, count() AS "Failed calls"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AND (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled')

panels.title: Backoffs by status
panels.description: Backoff waits before a retry (gen_ai.retry_wait events on model calls) each UTC day, by the status that caused them.
panels.sql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, multiIf(attrs['http.response.status_code'] NOT IN ('', '0'), attrs['http.response.status_code'],
              attrs['reason'] != '', attrs['reason'], 'unknown') AS status,
       count() AS "Backoffs"
FROM otel_traces ARRAY JOIN Events.Name AS ev, Events.Attributes AS attrs
WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AND ev = 'gen_ai.retry_wait'
GROUP BY day, status ORDER BY day, status

panels.title: Failures by provider and model
panels.description: Calls, failed calls, the error rate, the most frequent error class and the retries per call, by provider and model.
panels.sql:
SELECT if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS "Provider", if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS "Model", count() AS "Calls", countIf((StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled')) AS "Failed",
       round("Failed" / count(), 4) AS "Error rate",
       topKIf(1)(SpanAttributes['error.type'], (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled'))[1] AS "Top class",
       round(avg(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.retries'])), 2) AS "Retries / call"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']
GROUP BY "Provider", "Model" HAVING "Failed" > 0 OR "Retries / call" > 0
ORDER BY "Failed" DESC, "Calls" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: The range's failed runs, newest first: the workflow, when it started, how long it ran, and the first model or tool call in it that failed (its span name and status message) with its trace.
panels.sql:
WITH ai AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, TraceId, SpanName, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Duration,
         SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] AS op, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AS is_call, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AS is_tool, (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled') AS failed,
         if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS model, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS provider,
         toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) AS in_tok, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS out_tok, toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'])) AS cache_read_tok,
         toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd'])) AS cost, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.workflow.name'] AS workflow, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] AS run_id,
         SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS error_type, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool,
         SpanAttributes['user.id'] AS user_id, SpanAttributes['org.id'] AS org_id
  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '')),
runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, anyIf(workflow, workflow != '') AS wf,
         min(ts) AS started, max(addNanoseconds(ts, Duration)) AS ended,
         (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(ended) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(started)) / 1e9 AS seconds,
         countIf(op = 'invoke_workflow') AS segments,
         multiIf(segments = 0, 'In progress',
                 argMaxIf(error_type, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow') = 'canceled', 'Cancelled',
                 argMaxIf(failed, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow'), 'Failed', 'Succeeded') AS outcome,
         countIf(is_call) AS calls, countIf(is_tool) AS tools,
         sumIf(in_tok, is_call) AS run_in, sumIf(out_tok, is_call) AS run_out, sumIf(cost, is_call) AS run_cost
  FROM ai WHERE run_id != '' GROUP BY run_id),
first_failure AS (
  SELECT run_id, argMin(SpanName, ts) AS failed_span, argMin(StatusMessage, ts) AS failed_message, argMin(TraceId, ts) AS failed_trace
  FROM ai WHERE failed AND (is_call OR is_tool) AND run_id != '' GROUP BY run_id)
SELECT r.started AS "Started", if(r.wf = '', '(none)', r.wf) AS "Workflow", r.run_id AS "Run",
       round(r.seconds, 1) AS "Seconds", f.failed_span AS "First failure", f.failed_message AS "Message", f.failed_trace AS "Trace"
FROM runs AS r LEFT JOIN first_failure AS f ON f.run_id = r.run_id
WHERE r.outcome = 'Failed'
ORDER BY r.started DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Tool calls by tool
panels.description: Tool calls each UTC day: the ten tools called most in the range, the rest as Other.
panels.sql:
WITH calls AS (SELECT Timestamp AS ts, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool'),
